//dailyIntakeCap: Prologue rule (04.10.2026): protein and vitamins eaten in one day count only up to this many times the daily target. What is eaten past it is not absorbed and cannot be stored for later.

mindset.//: Prologue rule (05.10.2026, re-paced 06.10.2026): the third health track, a slow sum of the mood. The mood (Morale.level, capped at practice.json morale.levelCap either way, pain taken off) pushes the track every minute in proportion to its size: at the cap it goes from the start to the outermost band (Inspired upward, Despondent downward) in fullDays; half the cap takes twice as long; a mood of nothing leaves it where it is. There is no target and no drift back: a good stretch has to be lived to undo a bad one. Effects are the band's: a multiplier on work and travel speed, on stamina recovery and on wound healing. Nothing else reads it.

bands.label: Despondent
bands.hint: A long stretch of misery. Everything is slower, breath comes back slowly and wounds knit poorly. Good food, warmth, music and company lift it, slowly.

bands.label: Depressed
bands.hint: Low for days. Work and walking drag a little and breath comes back slower. Enjoyable meals and pastimes bring it back.

bands.label: Balanced
bands.hint: Steady. No help, no hindrance. Days of good mood lift it; days of bad meals, hunger or cold sink it.

bands.label: Thriving
bands.hint: Days of good food and pastimes. Breath comes back a little faster and wounds knit a little better.

bands.label: Inspired
bands.hint: A long run of good days. A little quicker at everything, breath back fast, wounds knitting well. It fades without the mood that made it.

bands.label: Severely deficient
bands.hint: Very low reserves. Illness is much more likely; strength and healing suffer. Recovery needs sustained nourishing meals.

bands.label: Very deficient
bands.hint: Resistance and recovery are reduced. Eat protein and vitamin-rich food regularly for the coming weeks.

bands.label: Deficient
bands.hint: Nutrition is below the healthy range. Regular nourishing meals will gradually restore it.

bands.label: Optimal
bands.hint: Enough to support normal immunity and maintenance. Keep eating regularly.

bands.label: Perfect
bands.hint: Well nourished. Protein can support training when you also work, eat enough energy and sleep. Extra intake gives no further resistance.

diseases.name: Common cold
diseases.symptoms: Runny nose, sore throat and mild fatigue.

diseases.name: Laryngitis
diseases.symptoms: Hoarse voice, irritating cough and sore throat.

diseases.name: Acute sinusitis
diseases.symptoms: Facial pressure, blocked nose and fatigue.

diseases.name: Influenza
diseases.symptoms: Fever, muscle aches and marked exhaustion.

diseases.name: Viral gastroenteritis
diseases.symptoms: Stomach cramps and diarrhoea; drink regularly.

diseases.name: Bacterial tonsillitis
diseases.symptoms: Fever and a painful swollen throat.

diseases.name: Bacterial folliculitis
diseases.symptoms: Tender infected hair follicles and skin irritation.

diseases.name: Bacterial pneumonia
diseases.symptoms: Fever, chest discomfort and breathlessness; antibiotics and rest help.

diseases.name: Scurvy
diseases.symptoms: Bleeding gums, bruising and poor wound healing. Vitamin-rich food is essential.

diseases.name: Protein malnutrition
diseases.symptoms: Muscle wasting, weakness and slow tissue repair. Protein and adequate energy are essential.
